star.name: STAR
star.intro: Tell a short true story in four parts: Situation, Task, Action, Result. Each box is one or two sentences.

parts.label: Situation
parts.question: Where were you, and what was going on?
parts.tip: Set the scene in one sentence. Name the place and when.
parts.good: At Valley Hardware in spring 2025, our online orders doubled in one month.
parts.bad: So there was this time at work when things got crazy.

parts.label: Task
parts.question: What was your job or goal?
parts.tip: Say what you were responsible for.
parts.good: My manager asked me to cut shipping delays without hiring more staff.
parts.bad: I had to deal with it.

parts.label: Action
parts.question: What did you do yourself?
parts.tip: Use "I," not "we." Name the exact steps you took.
parts.good: I set up a packing checklist and moved the label printer next to the packing table.

parts.label: Result
parts.question: What happened because of it?
parts.tip: Use a number if you can: time saved, money, people helped.
parts.good: Orders shipped in 1 day instead of 3, and complaints dropped by half.

bluf.name: BLUF
bluf.intro: Bottom Line Up Front: say your main point first, then why it matters.

parts.label: Bottom line
parts.question: If the reader only reads one sentence, what must it say?
parts.tip: Put the decision, answer, or ask here, with any date.
parts.good: Starting Monday, Nov 2, all time sheets are due by 5 p.m. Friday.
parts.bad: I wanted to share some thoughts about time sheets.

parts.label: Why it matters
parts.question: Why should the reader care?
parts.tip: One or two sentences. Say who it affects and how.
parts.good: Payroll needs the weekend to process checks on time.
parts.bad: There are various reasons for this.

prep.name: PREP
prep.intro: Make your case in four parts: Point, Reason, Example, Point again.

parts.label: Point
parts.question: What are you asking for or proposing?
parts.tip: Say it plainly in one sentence.
parts.good: I'd like to move the team meeting to Thursdays at 10 a.m.
parts.bad: Maybe we could think about changing some stuff.

parts.label: Reason
parts.question: Why is it a good idea?
parts.good: Monday mornings are our busiest time for customer calls.

parts.label: Example
parts.question: What proof or example backs it up?
parts.tip: Use a real number, date, or event.
parts.good: Last Monday, 14 calls went to voicemail during the meeting.

parts.label: Point again
parts.question: What do you want to happen next, and by when?
parts.tip: Repeat your point as a clear next step.
parts.good: Could we try Thursdays starting Nov 5?

apology.name: Apology formula
apology.intro: A real apology has four parts: admit it, own it, fix it, and prevent it.

parts.label: Admit it
parts.question: What went wrong? Say sorry for it.
parts.tip: Start with "I'm sorry" and name the exact problem.
parts.good: I'm sorry I missed our 2 p.m. meeting on Tuesday, Oct 27.
parts.bad: Sorry if you were upset about the thing.

parts.label: Own it
parts.question: How was it your fault?
parts.tip: Take responsibility. Skip excuses and don't blame others.
parts.good: I put it on my calendar for the wrong day.
parts.bad: My coworker messed up the schedule.

parts.label: Fix it
parts.question: What will you do to make it right?
parts.tip: Offer a specific fix, with a day or a time.
parts.good: I can meet any time Thursday or Friday, and I'll bring the full report.
parts.bad: I'll try to make it up to you somehow.

parts.label: Prevent it
parts.question: How will you stop it from happening again?
parts.good: I now set two reminders for every client meeting.

sbi.name: SBI
sbi.intro: Raise a problem without blame: Situation, Behavior, Impact. Stick to facts, not feelings about the person.

parts.label: Situation
parts.question: When and where did it happen?
parts.tip: Give the date, time, and place.
parts.good: On Saturday, Oct 24, I ordered a desk from your Valencia store.

parts.label: Behavior
parts.question: What happened? Stick to what anyone could see or hear.
parts.tip: Describe actions, not guesses about why.
parts.good: The desk arrived with a cracked top and two missing legs.

parts.label: Impact
parts.question: How did it affect you?
parts.tip: Say the real cost: time, money, or a missed plan.
parts.good: I had to take a day off work to wait for a second delivery.
